review: Inspected the complete section at mobile and desktop sizes. The three accounting scopes become labelled cards on mobile and a readable table on desktop. Body text, long identifiers and both evidence buttons wrap without clipping. Kernel, grouped-state and memory limitations remain adjacent to the numerical results.
scope: Selected section visual inspection only. Six viewport/JavaScript modes, keyboard entry and source/report downloads have separate automated checks; no full-library or attack-proof certification.
